results.title: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes: Ugly Baby
results.overview: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes shines in her 7th comedy special, exploring the adventures of family dynamics, embracing her current stage of life, and becoming a first-time mom in her later years.

results.title: Queen Elizabeth II: Her Story, Our Century
results.original_title: Queen Elizabeth II: Her Story, Our Century
results.overview: Marking what would have been Queen Elizabeth II’s 100th year, this landmark documentary tells the story of her life alongside a century of momentous change in Britain. Through archive and eyewitness reflections, the film explores how she led the monarchy through profound social, political and cultural change. Contributions from some of Britain’s best-known faces and international figures, including Dame Helen Mirren, Sir David Attenborough, Barack Obama and Queen Camilla, reveal how she remained a constant in a changing world.

results.title: This party is DEAD
results.overview: When responsible Alice, superficial Sofie, crazy Hanka, and insecure Roman head out to a Halloween party, they have no idea that a night of madness and chaos is about to begin. A chain of arguments, embarrassing moments, and bad decisions quickly spirals out of control, leading to absurd and wild situations involving zombies, police officers, and frustrated romantic comedy actors. On her mission to rescue her younger sister Kristýna, Alice discovers that the real danger lies not so much in the zombies as in mutual prejudices and poor role models.

results.title: Classmates
results.overview: An English teacher at  technical school in the outskirts of Rome knows that her twenty-four eighteen-year-old students do not consider her a human being, speak ill of her, are ready to contest her and feel a morbid curiosity towards her private life. Still, she tries to relate to them and the result of this effort is "a great love story". Cenciarelli describes the lessons (strictly in English, despite the students' protestations), the fights in and out of class, the students' tricks, their need to confront each other, their desire to show themselves superior, their weaknesses and their loneliness. As the seasons go by, the relationship between teacher and students becomes more complicated and deepens, alternating moments of great enthusiasm and great disappointment, until the baccalaureate exam, about which she cares more than they do.

results.title: Don’t Pick Up
results.overview: Tye, a young aspiring junior attorney working on behalf of a Texas oil company, is tasked with falsifying documents connected to a wrongful death lawsuit. However, Tye quickly learns the victim, a worker who drowned in crude oil, haunts the case and now him.

results.title: Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling in Sendai PIT
results.original_title: センダイガールズプロレスリング in 仙台PIT
results.overview: Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling in Sendai PIT was a professional wrestling event promoted by Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling, held on January 23, 2026, at Sendai PIT in Sendai, Miyagi, Japan.

results.title: A Whimsy Christmas Carol
results.overview: When the ambitious of a beloved toy company faces a looming corporate takeover, she must rediscover the true meaning of the holiday with the help of the Christmas Spirits  and a charming former flame who has always believed in her  or risk losing everything she’s worked so hard to build.

results.title: Saving Bella
results.overview: December 1941. Leningrad. A soldier is assigned to guard the city zoo in the midst of World War II. There, among starving workers and dying animals, he forms an unexpected bond with Bella the hippo. As the siege tightens, this fragile connection becomes his only anchor, forcing him to choose between survival and compassion in a world falling apart.

results.title: Carabalí
results.overview: An Afro-Colombian community leader is threatened and forced into exile in Mexico, where she rebuilds her life while keeping her fight alive.

results.title: Hasut
results.overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

results.title: One Night Stand
results.overview: A married man's reckless decision to cheat during a night out spirals into a deadly nightmare when his mysterious hookup turns out to be a calculated serial killer targeting unfaithful men. As she embeds herself deeper into his life-stalking him, infiltrating his workplace, and getting dangerously close to his pregnant wife-he's forced to confront the consequences of his betrayal before everything he loves is destroyed.

results.title: Summer Delivery
results.overview: In traditional Chinese culture, red eggs symbolize fortune and happiness. On a day filled with significance, seven-year-old Aileen, a country girl, sets off for the city, carrying a red egg—a precious gift for the one she holds dearest. When her bike falters midway through her journey, a quirky yet kind delivery driver unexpectedly becomes her guardian on this adventure. This poignant tale captures the bittersweet journey of growth.

results.title: Mario
results.overview: Ronald Reagan’s America sets the stage for Mario Cuomo, the son of Italian immigrants who rose to become Governor of New York and, in his defining 1984 DNC speech, offered a powerful vision of leadership rooted in compassion.

results.title: Otium
results.overview: Hanna is a real estate photographer from Mississauga who commutes daily to Toronto to snap pictures of luxury apartments for a network of shady, elusive corporations. With his debut feature, director Christopher Beaulieu provides an illuminating insight into the notion of liminality and the economic dispossession of younger generations. Favouring a detached approach, where the warmth of his celluloid images clashes with the cold functionality of Hanna’s digital photographs, where the nostalgia of past prosperity seamlessly seeps into the film material, Otium shows a rare kind of lucidity. Probing the spacious depths of empty dwellings, it tells of the contemporary Tantaluses of Hanna’s generation, for whom the gig economy provides dreams of wealth that it will make sure to keep unfulfilled.

results.title: Ein Sommer in Italien – WM 1990
results.overview: Documentary from Nadja Kölling and Vanessa Nöcker about the soccer world championship 1990 in Italy.

results.title: Remember Me Always
results.overview: One night, Tomás, a hotel manager with a criminal past, confronts a guest playing loud music in the lobby, who claims to be waiting for her lover. He soon learns his former criminal group, led by his brother, wants to capture her to force the lover -apparently hiding in the hotel- to appear. In an effort to protect this unknown woman, Tomás faces the past he's tried to escape.

results.title: Tumi Ami Shudhu
results.overview: Love, emotions, and the beauty of unspoken connections — Tumi Ami Shudhu brings a heartfelt romantic journey that feels real, warm, and deeply relatable.﻿

results.title: Powerplay - The Best Ice Hockey Team for the Olympics
results.original_title: Powerplay - Das beste Eishockey-Team für Olympia
results.overview: In Febuary 2026 the world's best ice hockey players will descend on Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo for the most eagerly awaited XXV Olympic Winter Games in living memory. For German national coach Harry Kreis the twelve months leading up to the final nominations of his olympic squad are equally exciting and stressful - a period plagued with difficult decisions and sleepless nights. A young team falters at the world championships, struggling under the pressure of the big stage, while older statesmen wait in the wings ready to replace them. The start of the domestic season offers a chance to impress the head coach, but the intense schedule heightens the risk of injury. Ultimately it's up to coach Kreis to make the final cut: who will play and who will be left at home?
